title: Siao Pah Tseu

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 49
Date 23/12/18 AM
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

December 23rd 1918.

Sir,
General Yang has so far received no definite reply to his application to be allowed to resign nor has a successor being appointed should he go on leave. General Lu of Woosung is visiting Loongwha daily.
The timber merchants established along the Nantao Bund have received instructions from the City Authorities to remove their timber and also their loading wharves further up the river. They have petitioned against this but having received no reply they will hold a meeting in their Guild at Nantao on the 24th inst. to discuss the matter.
Siao Pah Tseu 萧百秋 one of the leaders of the so-called Rebel party who was reported yesterday as having severed his connection therewith has been compelled to alter his decision as he was not in a position to pay back to his subordinates certain money received, the return of which was a condition of his being allowed to resign.
The students from nearly all the schools in Shanghai paid a visit of condolence to the house of the late General Hwaung Hsin on the 22nd inst. The funeral will take place at 10 a.m. to-day.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记册
第 49 号
日期：1918 年 12 月 23 日上午
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1918 年 12 月 23 日。

先生：

杨将军迄今未收到关于准许其辞职申请的明确答复，若其休假，继任人选亦未任命。吴淞的卢将军每日前往龙华。

沿南市外滩设立的木材商已收到市政当局指令，要求将其木材及装载码头迁往河流上游更远处。他们已对此提出请愿，但未获答复，故将于本月 24 日在南市公会举行会议讨论此事。

所谓“反叛派”领导人之一的萧百秋，据昨日报道已与该股势力断绝关系，但被迫改变决定，因为他无力向部下退还某些款项，而退还款项是其获准辞职的条件。

22 日，上海几乎所有学校的学生均前往已故黄兴将军寓所吊唁。葬礼将于今日上午 10 时举行。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长

警务处总监
